```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

here::i_am("dominoSignal_analysis/p21_sorted_aged_adipose/dominoSignal.Rmd")
source(here::here("dominoSignal_analysis", "p21_sorted_aged_adipose", "paths.R"))

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dominoSignal, lib.loc = dominoSignal_local_path)
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readxl)
  library(Seurat)
  library(readr)
})

```


# Read in Seurat object, create annotation column with GFP +/- macrophages, extract matrices
```{r}
seu <- readRDS(file.path(p21_path, "data/GSE269660_GFP_pos_neg_fat_All.rds"))

seu$CellTypes_GFPStatus <- as.character(seu$CellTypes)
seu$CellTypes_GFPStatus[seu$CellTypes_GFPStatus == "Macrophages"] <- paste0(seu$CellTypes_GFPStatus[seu$CellTypes_GFPStatus == "Macrophages"], "_", seu$GFP_status[seu$CellTypes_GFPStatus == "Macrophages"])

counts <- GetAssayData(seu, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
dim(counts)
z_scores <- GetAssayData(seu, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
z_scores <- t(scale(t(z_scores)))
dim(z_scores)
clusters <- seu[["CellTypes_GFPStatus"]]
str(clusters)
clusters <- as.factor(clusters[,1])
names(clusters) <- colnames(seu)
table(clusters)
```


# pyscenic results
```{r}
auc <- read.table(file.path(p21_path, "results/scenic_results/auc_aged_adipose.csv"), header = T, row.names = 1, stringsAsFactors = F, sep = ",")
colnames(auc) <- sapply(colnames(auc), gsub, pattern = "\\.\\.\\.", replacement = "")
regulon_df <- read.csv(file.path(p21_path, "results/scenic_results/regulons_aged_adipose.csv"), skip = 2)
regulon_colnames <- c("TF", "MotifID", "AUC", "NES", "MotifSimilarityQvalue", "OrthologousIdentity", "Annotation", "Context", "TargetGenes", "RankAtMax")
colnames(regulon_df) <- regulon_colnames
regulon_ls <- create_regulon_list_scenic(regulon_df)
```

# cellphoneDB interactions
```{r}
cellphonedb <- readRDS(here::here("dominoSignal_analysis", "cellphoneDB", "cpdb_rl_map.rds"))
```


# run dominoSignal
```{r}
dom <- create_domino(
  rl_map = cellphonedb,
  features = t(auc),
  counts = counts,
  z_scores = z_scores,
  clusters = clusters,
  tf_targets = regulon_ls,
  use_clusters = T,
  use_complexes = T,
  remove_rec_dropout = F
) %>% build_domino(
  dom = .,
  min_tf_pval = .001,
  max_tf_per_clust = Inf,
  max_rec_per_tf = Inf,
  rec_tf_cor_threshold = .25
)
```


```{r}
saveRDS(dom, here::here("dominoSignal_analysis", "p21_sorted_aged_adipose", "domino.rds"))
```


# Signaling network dataframe
```{r}
df <- network2df(dom)

df.reformat <- df %>%
  select(ligand, receptor, transcription_factor, ligand_mean_z_score, receptor_mean_z_score, median_tf_auc, sending_cluster, receiving_cluster, data_wide_cor, cluster_cor) %>%
  rename(ligand_exp = ligand_mean_z_score, receptor_exp = receptor_mean_z_score, tf_auc = median_tf_auc, sending_cl = sending_cluster, receiving_cl = receiving_cluster)

write.csv(df.reformat, here::here("gEAR_implementation_of_dominoSignal", "p21_sorted_aged_adipose", "domino_network.reformatted.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

sink(file = here::here("dominoSignal_analysis", "p21_sorted_aged_adipose", "sessionInfo.txt"))
